prompt: Edit the supplied first-pass card to match the native export exactly. The target is a compact 390×410 component crop with the card filling most of the canvas, not a full-height phone screenshot. Remove the 9:41/signal/Wi-Fi/battery status bar and remove all large blank white space below the card. Use the native preview as the exact authority for card bounds, section proportions, divider positions, content placement and Japanese text. Preserve the existing small circular group photo exactly as shown in the native preview: same three people, same crop, same scale and same position at the left of the course row; do not redraw, retouch, recolor, or replace faces. Keep all card surfaces white, dividers neutral gray and progress bars/button flat forest green with no tint fills. Preserve exact native Japanese wording, including the course name and the recommended-review line; do not add or rephrase text. Keep the same top score, course row, review timing and button arrangement. No additional UI, extra status icons, gradients, shadows, or decorative effects. The attached user palette image is color guidance only.
reviewNotes: Restored compact 390x410 native crop, removed status bar and excess blank space, kept white/neutral surfaces and solid green controls. Circular group photo remains visually consistent. Pending owner review.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
